summary: Recovered /srv/archive online. Utilization fell from 100% to 7%, and archiveapp can write successfully to incoming.
actions_performed: Identified a 690,073,600-byte unexpected telemetry debug capture.
Confirmed no process had the capture open.
Removed only /srv/archive/.telemetry-cache/collector-debug.capture; the deletion is not locally recoverable without a backup.
Preserved the XFS filesystem and existing archive records.
Verified an archiveapp-owned test write, then removed the test artifact.

evidence.summary: The hidden telemetry cache contained one 690,073,600-byte collector debug capture, with no process holding it open.
Usage was initially 100%; after removing the debug capture it measured 7% with 659 MiB available.

evidence.requirement: Ensure archiveapp can write to incoming
evidence.summary: The baseline archiveapp write failed with ENOSPC. After recovery, archiveapp created and synced a 17-byte file owned archiveapp:archiveapp with mode 0640.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the filesystem and existing archive data
evidence.summary: The manifest checksum remained c27a3936f654dcb08a389ac6bb44555e46c91969e8f7767490f219e83f0c009e, ownership and permissions remained intact, and /dev/loop0 stayed mounted read-write as XFS.
